next_single_step: Find why only the RAMDisk entry (the only entry whose blob_head crosses 0x1000_0000_0000 + ramdisk size into a higher address after ROUND_NEXT_PAGE) loses its upper bits — audit set_adt_mmap/push_adt_mmap call chain for the RAMDisk END_ENTRY with special attention to any 32-bit intermediate in the blob arithmetic or ADT property write. Then apply the smallest fix in qemu-sptm hw/arm/xnuboot_sptm.c, rebuild only qemu, rerun the 15s first-exception gate.
root_cause: RAMDisk DT memory-map entry address is truncated to 32 bits (0x100076a0000 -> 0x076a0000). All other entries are absolute. This single truncated entry, plus topOfKernelData being DRAM-relative, feeds the SPTM page-index producer at 0d5700 with a coordinate that underflows against physBase=0x10000000000, producing wrapped page index 0xfc0057a8, which translates to the faulting low address 0x3ef015ea0000 family.

pristine_boot_args.note: topOfKernelData is DRAM-relative offset (end of RAMDisk blob), not absolute
